title: Network Participation Agreements: Claim Volume and the Number of Plan Runs
content:
**Volume reduction.** A practice under the **Network Participation Agreements** that is paid a high volume of claims on an agreement repays a repayment plan on it over fewer claim payment runs. The plan volume reduction of the plan run count is set by the agreement's claim payments in remittances dated fewer than 3 whole months before today:

- 40000 USD or more removes 4 runs;
- 20000 USD or more but less than 40000 USD removes 2 runs;
- less than 20000 USD removes nothing.

## Terms

- **Claim payments in the window.** The total of the claim payment amounts on the agreement's remittances whose date is fewer than 3 whole months before today. Capitation and prompt-pay interest payments are not claim payments.
- **Whole months** are the difference in calendar months from the remittance date to today, less one when today's day of the month is smaller than the remittance date's day of the month.

## Worked judgements (hypothetical totals)

| Claim payments in the window | Runs removed |
|---|---|
| 19999.99 USD | None |
| 20000.00 USD | 2 |
| 39999.99 USD | 2 |
| 40000.00 USD | 4 |
